scientific_boundaries: These are authentic published MassBank record files annotated as measurements of a known reference standard, not new Cannabiverse experiments or ancient cannabis residues.
Source records assert confidence standard compound, not independent validation by Cannabiverse of the compound, vendor acquisition, or all metadata.
A positive/negative neutral-mass agreement does not uniquely identify the compound and does not prove occurrence in a biological sample.
Different instrument types, ionization modes and collision energies make fragment-count and intensity comparisons non-equivalent.
No experimental source is equated to the CC0-labeled MassIVE cannabis dataset MSV000093886.
